item.title: Deadlines approaching for May Fair events, scholarships
item.description: It’s deadline season for the Dixon May Fair – both for youth planning to compete at the annual fair, and youth hoping to earn scholarships for future educational endeavors. In the market animal competition, youth intending to exhibit livestock at the 2026 Dixon May Fair must have their animals pre-tagged in order to compete during the Fair, which is scheduled to run May 7-10.
